description: Compare paying hosted CI overage against running self-hosted runners, including the maintenance hours people forget to cost. Reports the true break-even volume.

engineerHourlyCost.description: Fully-loaded engineer cost per hour in USD (default 75)

maintenanceHoursPerMonth.description: Hours per month spent maintaining self-hosted runners (default 4)

monthlyMinutes.description: Current hosted runner minutes per month

runnerHostingCostPerMonth.description: Monthly infra cost for the self-hosted runner(s) in USD (default 20)

name: estimate_selfhosted_tco
